featured_reviews.review_text: This is a fabulous bakery they have the best desserts in town I really loved their dream cake in tiramisu flavour. It was freshly made in front of me. featured_reviews.name: Rohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is heaven for Dessert lovers and In case you love your dessert to be made with perfection, this is all you need!!

We ordered for:
Tiramisu: This was eggless tiramisu with balaced coffee Flavour, It wasn't bitter like usual but on switter side, Texture was really good and Loved it!!

Raspberry cheesecake: This was one of the best cheesecake and raspberry sauce on top was the main highlight, bcz of its freshness and Cheesecake texture was just on point!

Chocolate Hazelnut cake: I tried their half kg cake which was THE BEST, sponge was so moise and cream layering was done keeping all the perfection!!

Overall we absolutely loved whatever we tried and looking forward to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Drashti Maniyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
KTP craft really sells one of the best brookies I've ever had. Period.
Also tried their mango cheesecake which was really amazing.
The tiramisu was a bomb for hard-core coffee lovers.
Coming to the best part, they serve 5-star type plated desserts which you'll get in a bento box and can enjoy them right there that too at cheaper rates than any restaurants.
We had orange tart triangle and vaccine 2023. OTT was amazing with dense dark chocolate and perfectly made tart and vaccine 2023 was a mango bomb.

featured_reviews.name: Amber Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: My family has been ordering cakes from Indulge since 6 years now! I know, quite a loyal customer lol. But truly the cakes and their cookies and the brownies too they’re surreal and the cakes are delivered with utmost care 😊 thanks and cheers to the whole team. Although im editing this review since one time they forgot to add details to a customized cake and honestly it was disappointing to which I told them what went wrong and they tried to correct it only after mentioning that these things were missing from the cake, other than that for my 25th birthday they refused to bake a cake “saying that she has high expectations from us and we wouldn’t want to bake a cake for her” this was only because I corrected them, and it was the team’s fault. It’s very disappointing from a customer’s point of view since all I did was let them know what was wrong 🙂
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Amber,

Thank you for your honest feedback, and I’m truly sorry if it felt like your order was declined because you corrected me. That was not my intention at all.

In my 20+ years of baking professionally, I’ve learned that feedback is an important part of the process, and I always welcome it as it helps us do better.

The request for your birthday fell on a Tuesday, which is our weekly day off. I was concerned that preparing the cake a day in advance, given the design you had chosen, might affect how it looked and held up. As I already had prior commitments that day, I didn’t want to risk compromising the final result for such an important occasion.

My only intention was to ensure that your celebration received the quality it deserves.

I sincerely apologise for any disappointment caused.

Warm regards,
Fay

featured_reviews.name: Isha Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently ordered a cake from Indulge for my dad’s 75th birthday , but unfortunately, the experience was quite disappointing. The cake delivered was completely different from the design which I selected and showed them and which I had initially ordered. To make matters worse, the team did not share any preview photos of the final product before delivery, so I had no idea what to expect. Seeing a different design at the last minute was a major letdown. I hope Indulge takes customer requirements and communication more seriously in the future.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Isha,

We were quite surprised to see your one-star review.

When we initially asked for feedback, you mentioned that everyone loved the cake, although you personally didn’t get a chance to see or taste it as you were occupied at the time. Later, you shared an image taken from the back of the cake at an unusual angle and mentioned that certain elements were missing, even though they are still partially visible in the same image.

We’re genuinely open to feedback and always use it to improve our work. However, this particular review feels confusing and does not fully align with our discussions about design and flavour.

For clarity and transparency, we have posted our image of the cake on our google profile as well as attached our initial conversation along with a clearer image of the cake for anyone who would like to understand the full context on an unlisted page on our website linked below.

I do apologise if you or your guests were dissatisfied with the cake, we will try and communicate more clearly in the future to avoid any misunderstandings.

We remain committed to honest communication and delivering quality, and we truly value feedback that helps us grow.

Thanks & regards,
Indulge Custom Cakes

The best part? They also have vegan and sugar-free options, which was perfect for my sister. The café itself has a lovely vibe, making it a great spot to indulge in premium, pure-veg desserts. Definitely worth a visit! 🍰

featured_reviews.name: Shivraj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Theobroma has firmly secured its place as my go-to destination for a perfect blend of exceptional coffee and heavenly brownies. Stepping into their outlet, one can't help but admire the well-decorated space, adorned in the classic style that is synonymous with Theobroma.

The menu, as always, offers a delightful array of options, ranging from aromatic coffee and delectable cakes to scrumptious bread and, of course, their signature brownies. The consistent quality of their offerings is a testament to Theobroma's commitment to culinary excellence.

In the midst of this culinary haven, I did notice a potential area for enhancement during my visit—the staff, while friendly, seemed a bit overwhelmed. Perhaps investing in additional training could further elevate their service and ensure a more seamless experience for customers.

Despite this minor observation, my overall satisfaction with Theobroma remains unwavering. The food quality, as expected, was superb with no complaints whatsoever. I eagerly anticipate my next visit, hopeful that the team will address the staff training aspect, enhancing an already exceptional dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: divya venkat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered a pineapple pastry and two brownies @ ₹110 each via swiggy. Recieved one brownie box with two of the smallest brownie squares I've ever seen, and the kicker? They were terrible. They hadn't been heated and the oil in them had a terrible bitter aftertaste in the back of my throat.

Oh, also, I recieved a chocolate pastry with the listed price of ₹125 when the pineapple pastry was ₹135. It wasn't good either and tasted like water.

I will also add that all these were eggless, and that is not in any way an excuse for bad taste, especially at such unreasonable prices. I'm no stranger to the oven myself and my cake does not taste like water, nor do my brownies taste of rancid oil. It's insulting. Either serve goods worth the price you list, or none at all.

I have tried the cheesecake, however, which was awesome, but this order cost ₹500 and that is not a small amount.
